name: ACT interstate training travel support for apprentices
summary: ACT apprentices whose qualification needs interstate block training can claim travel support after returning.
how: Email a signed and stamped Application for Interstate Training Travel Support form to skills@act.gov.au.
catches: Claims must reach Skills Canberra within 3 months of the block training.
The page gives no amount or detailed eligibility.

evidence.quote: Payment for travel support is made to eligible Australian Apprentices when they return from interstate training.
